items.exemplar:
A. American industry became the 'Arsenal of Democracy': Lend-Lease (1941) shipped tanks, trucks, and planes to Britain and the USSR before America even entered the war.

B. American forces turned the tide in both theaters — halting Japan at Midway (1942) and opening the second front with the D-Day invasion of Normandy (1944).

C. The home front was transformed: women entered factories as 'Rosie the Riveter,' African Americans migrated to war jobs, and the federal government managed the economy through rationing and price controls.
parts: A. Briefly explain ONE example of an American military contribution to Allied victory in World War II.
B. Briefly explain a SECOND example of that military contribution.
C. Briefly explain ONE effect of World War II on the American home front.
items.stimulus:
President Truman's August 1945 announcement told the nation that an American plane had dropped a single bomb on Hiroshima with explosive force equal to more than 20,000 tons of TNT — a weapon, he said, that would shorten the agony of war.
—After President Harry Truman's press release, August 6, 1945
